articles.title: Rahul Gandhi Faces Growing Political Challenges and Opposition Tensions in India
articles.summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi faces mounting political pressure in India as his calls for protests against the election process fail to gain widespread public support. Amid rising tensions with the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party, Gandhi also contends with competition from new groups like the Cockroach Janta Party and criticism from allies over his strategy.

articles.title: Dhal Singh Bisen sworn in as Uttarakhand Governor
articles.summary: Dhal Singh Bisen took the oath of office as the new Governor of Uttarakhand at Lok Bhavan. He was sworn in by Acting Chief Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari in a formal ceremony. Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami and other senior officials were present to witness the occasion. Bisen previously served as a legislator and a minister in Madhya Pradesh.

articles.title: SARAS Mela moves beyond Delhi-NCR, brings 1,500 rural women entrepreneurs to Vijayawada
articles.summary: The National SARAS Mela in Vijayawada showcases around 1,500 women entrepreneurs from various states and union territories. Organized under the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Rural Livelihoods Mission, the event focuses on market access. Workshops on branding, packaging, and digital marketing enhance business skills for participants. The government aims to help women achieve sustainable incomes of at least Rs 1 lakh annually.

articles.title: Mumbai Police Probe Attack on Bollywood Actor Tiger Shroff
articles.summary: Mumbai police launched an attempt to murder investigation after three unidentified gunmen fired at Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff's vehicle in the Juhu area on Sunday evening. The actor escaped unhurt, but his driver and another person sustained injuries. The case was transferred to the Mumbai Police Crime Branch on Monday.

articles.title: Chhattisgarh teachers get lucrative posting with fake orders
articles.summary: RAIPUR: In Chhattisgarh’s School Education Department, apparent bureaucratic negligence and forgery expose how astonishingly easy it is to hoodwink the state apparatus. From counterfeit transfer lists carrying forged seals of the Secretariat to fabricated earlier public circulars declaring extended school holidays, bogus official orders are not merely circulating—they are slipping through official scrutiny and ironically being enforced on the ground.

articles.title: India’s Finance Minister blames easy exits and excess liquidity for equity market's

articles.title: Indiana Former Legal Secretary Faces Charges For Forged Record Expungements
articles.summary: An Indiana former legal secretary faces forty five charges after a three year police investigation into fake criminal record expungements. Thirty seven year old Heather Ann Textor of Lowell was arrested after clients who paid to clear their records allegedly received forged court documents and fake letters from state officials. The investigation revealed missing legal fees and fraudulent documents.

articles.title: Youuber Dhruv Rathee Detained During Protests in India
articles.summary: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained by police at his Gurugram residence on October 10 after joining Cockroach Janta Party protests in Bengaluru and Delhi. The movement demands the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral roll irregularities. Rathee shifted from online commentary to street activism, while opposition leader Rahul Gandhi supported the demonstrations.

articles.title: UT spends less than half of capital budget in first 6 months
articles.summary: The Chandigarh administration has failed to spend even 50% of the annual budget allocated under the capital head by the Centre in the first six months of the 2026-27 financial year. The administration has spent just around 45. 1% in the capital segment, which is meant for infrastructure, buildings and related developmental works.

articles.title: Shots Fired at Tiger Shroff’s Car in Mumbai; Actor Escapes Unhurt
articles.summary: Police have launched an intensive manhunt to trace those behind the attack. According to reports, three rounds were fired at the actor’s BMW while he was returning home after a football session. Although the gunfire triggered panic, Tiger Shroff escaped unhurt and is safe. However, the actor’s driver sustained injuries during the incident and was rushed to Nanavati Hospital.

articles.title: Neemuch Police Arrest Four Members of Interstate Cyber Fraud Gang

articles.summary_hi: टैलेंट500 सर्वेक्षण के अनुसार, भारतीय प्रौद्योगिकी पेशेवर तेजी से ऐसे नियोक्ताओं की तलाश कर रहे हैं जो व्यावहारिक कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (एआई) अनुभव और स्पष्ट रूप से परिभाषित करियर पथ प्रदान करते हैं, जबकि बहुराष्ट्रीय वैश्विक क्षमता केंद्र (जीसीसी) कई लोगों के लिए पसंदीदा अगले करियर कदम के रूप में उभर रहे हैं। टैलेंट500 एएनएसआर का हिस्सा है, जिसने भारत में 200 से अधिक जीसीसी स्थापित किए हैं।

articles.summary_hinglish: tailenta500 sarvekshana ke anusar, bharatiya praudyogiki peshevara teji se aise niyoktaon ki talasha kara rahe hain jo vyavaharika kritrima buddhimatta (eaaee) anubhava aura spashta rupa se paribhashita kariyara patha pradana karate hain, jabaki bahurashtriya vaishvika kshamata kendra (jisisi) kaee logon ke lie pasandida agale kariyara kadama ke rupa men ubhara rahe hain। tailenta500 eenaesaaara ka hissa hai, jisane bharata men 200 se adhika jisisi sthapita kie hain।

articles.title: The future of technology is expanding beyond big cities: Can enterprise AI emerge
articles.summary: Nellore, a city in Andhra Pradesh, is becoming a test case for that question. In November 2025, entrepreneur Renil Komitla launched Blazeup, an enterprise artificial intelligence platform, from his hometown rather than a traditional technology hub. The platform brings together functions such as human resources, finance, IT service management, project management and customer relationship management within a common system.
articles.title_hi: प्रौद्योगिकी का भविष्य बड़े शहरों से आगे बढ़ रहा है: क्या उद्यम एआई उभर सकता है
articles.summary_hi: आंध्र प्रदेश का एक शहर नेल्लोर, उस प्रश्न का परीक्षण मामला बनता जा रहा है। नवंबर 2025 में, उद्यमी रेनिल कोमिटला ने पारंपरिक प्रौद्योगिकी केंद्र के बजाय अपने गृहनगर से एक उद्यम कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता प्लेटफॉर्म ब्लेज़अप लॉन्च किया। प्लेटफ़ॉर्म मानव संसाधन, वित्त, आईटी सेवा प्रबंधन, परियोजना प्रबंधन और ग्राहक संबंध प्रबंधन जैसे कार्यों को एक सामान्य प्रणाली में एक साथ लाता है।
articles.title_hinglish: praudyogiki ka bhavishya badaे shaharon se aage badha raha hai: kya udyama eaaee ubhara sakata hai
articles.summary_hinglish: aandhra pradesha ka eka shahara nellor, usa prashna ka parikshana mamala banata ja raha hai। navanbara 2025 men, udyami renila komitala ne paranparika praudyogiki kendra ke bajaya apane grihanagara se eka udyama kritrima buddhimatta pletaphorma blejaapa loncha kiya। pletaphaॉrma manava sansadhan, vitt, aaeeti seva prabandhan, pariyojana prabandhana aura grahaka sanbandha prabandhana jaise karyon ko eka samanya pranali men eka satha lata hai।

articles.title: Two global tech centres to come up in North Karnataka region
articles.summary: Recently, the state government, under the Local Economy Accelerator Programme (LEAP), approved the establishment of GTCs of 10,000 sqft each in Hubballi and Belagavi with the objective of expanding Karnataka’s technology growth beyond Bengaluru. IT Minister Priyank Kharge stated that the GTCs, with plug-and-play facilities, are aimed at providing technology talent, startups and entrepreneurship with the infrastructure and opportunities locally.
articles.title_hi: उत्तरी कर्नाटक क्षेत्र में दो वैश्विक तकनीकी केंद्र खुलेंगे
articles.summary_hi: हाल ही में, राज्य सरकार ने स्थानीय अर्थव्यवस्था त्वरक कार्यक्रम (एलईएपी) के तहत, बेंगलुरु से परे कर्नाटक की प्रौद्योगिकी वृद्धि का विस्तार करने के उद्देश्य से हुबली और बेलगावी में प्रत्येक में 10,000 वर्ग फुट के जीटीसी की स्थापना को मंजूरी दी। आईटी मंत्री प्रियांक खड़गे ने कहा कि प्लग-एंड-प्ले सुविधाओं के साथ जीटीसी का उद्देश्य स्थानीय स्तर पर बुनियादी ढांचे और अवसरों के साथ प्रौद्योगिकी प्रतिभा, स्टार्टअप और उद्यमिता प्रदान करना है।
articles.title_hinglish: uttari karnataka kshetra men do vaishvika takaniki kendra khulenge
articles.summary_hinglish: hala hi men, rajya sarakara ne sthaniya arthavyavastha tvaraka karyakrama (elaeeepi) ke tahat, bengaluru se pare karnataka ki praudyogiki vriddhi ka vistara karane ke uddeshya se hubali aura belagavi men pratyeka men 10,000 varga phuta ke jitisi ki sthapana ko manjuri di। aaeeti mantri priyanka khadage ne kaha ki plaga-enda-ple suvidhaon ke satha jitisi ka uddeshya sthaniya stara para buniyadi dhanche aura avasaron ke satha praudyogiki pratibh, startaapa aura udyamita pradana karana hai।

articles.title: International Wildlife Racket Hits Odisha: STF Clueless as Orangutan Smuggling
articles.summary: The prime suspect and alleged mastermind behind the operation, Jayanta Maiti, alongside his son, remains at large. Efforts by the STF to apprehend the duo or secure concrete evidence against them have proven futile. While interrogations were conducted with employees at Maiti’s hotel and his family members, investigators failed to gather actionable leads.

articles.title: 'No satisfaction unless I play for India': Gurjapneet Singh after four-wicket haul against
articles.summary: For Gurjapneet Singh, a strong performance in domestic cricket is only another step towards a bigger goal. The Tamil Nadu left-arm pacer made an immediate impact against Uttarakhand in the Ranji Trophy, claiming four wickets on the opening day, but insisted that his job would remain unfinished until he earns a chance to represent India.

articles.title: Akshay Kumar meets Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami, discusses state’s film policy
articles.summary: Bollywood actor Akshay Kumar met Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami at his official residence, where the two discussed the state’s film policy and its potential to attract more film productions. During the meeting, Dhami spoke about Uttarakhand’s efforts to establish itself as a preferred destination for filmmakers, citing its natural beauty, cultural heritage and investor-friendly policies.

articles.title: Tiger Shroff Unhurt After Firing In Mumbai, Driver Injured
articles.summary: Mumbai, Oct. 18: Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff escaped unhurt after unidentified persons allegedly opened fire at a car carrying him in Mumbai’s Juhu area on Sunday evening, police said. Two people, including the actor’s driver, were reportedly injured. The incident occurred near Pushpa Park within the jurisdiction of Juhu police station.
articles.title_hi: मुंबई में गोलीबारी के बाद टाइगर श्रॉफ घायल, ड्राइवर घायल
articles.summary_hi: मुंबई, 18 अक्टूबर: बॉलीवुड अभिनेता टाइगर श्रॉफ रविवार शाम को मुंबई के जुहू इलाके में अज्ञात व्यक्तियों द्वारा उन्हें ले जा रही एक कार पर कथित तौर पर गोलीबारी करने के बाद सुरक्षित बच गए, पुलिस ने कहा। कथित तौर पर अभिनेता के ड्राइवर सहित दो लोग घायल हो गए। यह घटना जुहू पुलिस स्टेशन के अधिकार क्षेत्र में पुष्पा पार्क के पास हुई।

articles.title: ₹3,000 pension won't block parents' medical reimbursement for Haryana govt employees, High
articles.summary: The ruling is significant for government employees whose parents require hospitalisation or treatment but have modest pension income. It reinforces the principle that the receipt of a small social-security benefit does not automatically establish that an elderly parent can independently meet medical expenses. The court held that administrative instructions cannot override the statutory rules governing medical reimbursement.

articles.title: Rajnath Singh to Represent India at SCO Meeting in Tajikistan on October 19–20
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh will represent India at the twenty-fifth meeting of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Council of Heads of Government in Dushanbe, Tajikistan, on October nineteen to twenty, 2026. According to the Ministry of Defence, discussions will focus on trade, investment, connectivity, innovation, and cultural exchanges to advance regional economic engagement among member states.
articles.title_hi: राजनाथ सिंह 19-20 अक्टूबर को ताजिकिस्तान में एससीओ बैठक में भारत का प्रतिनिधित्व करेंगे

articles.title: Eugenio Chacarra Wins In India, Takes Race To Dubai Lead
articles.summary: The 26-year-old Spaniard captured the DP World India Championship on Sunday, October 18, finishing at 21-under 267 to claim a two-stroke victory over New Zealand's Daniel Hillier. More importantly, Chacarra leapfrogged Patrick Reed for the top spot in the Race to Dubai standings, setting up a fascinating finish to the DP World Tour season.
articles.title_hi: यूजेनियो चकार्रा ने भारत में जीत हासिल की, दुबई की दौड़ में आगे रहे

articles.title_hinglish: yujeniyo chakarra ne bharata men jita hasila ki, dubaee ki dauda men aage rahe

articles.title: Nagaland students travel less to school, but those who do pay more
articles.summary: Among others, the NHTS informed that only 46. 7% of students aged six and above in Nagaland travelled at least 1 km to educational institutions, the lowest share among States and UTs against the national average of 66. 4%. However, travel remains relatively expensive for the smaller proportion of students undertaking the activity.
articles.title_hi: नागालैंड के छात्र स्कूल जाने के लिए कम यात्रा करते हैं, लेकिन जो लोग यात्रा करते हैं उन्हें अधिक भुगतान करना पड़ता है
articles.summary_hi: अन्य बातों के अलावा, एनएचटीएस ने बताया कि नागालैंड में छह वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु के केवल 46.7% छात्रों ने शैक्षणिक संस्थानों में कम से कम 1 किमी की यात्रा की, जो राष्ट्रीय औसत 66.4% के मुकाबले राज्यों और केंद्रशासित प्रदेशों में सबसे कम हिस्सेदारी है। हालाँकि, गतिविधि में भाग लेने वाले छोटे छात्रों के लिए यात्रा अपेक्षाकृत महंगी बनी हुई है।

articles.title: Protests in National Capital Risk ₹4,000 Crore in Business Losses, Warns Traders

articles.title: KKR star batter smashes back-to-back Ranji Trophy centuries, makes strong statement
articles.summary: Batting in the middle order, Rinku reached his century off 155 deliveries, helping Uttar Pradesh strengthen their position on the opening day of the match. His consecutive hundreds have once again highlighted his consistency in domestic cricket and raised questions about whether he could earn opportunities with India in the longer format.

articles.title: CJI Inaugurates Ladakh Bench Of HC In Leh; Historic Milestone, Says LG
articles.summary: Leh, Oct 18: Chief Justice of India Justice Surya Kant on Sunday inaugurated the Ladakh Bench of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh here. Ladakh Lt Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena called the day a landmark milestone, fulfilling a long-standing demand for a court closer to home. "A new era of accessible justice begins in Ladakh!
